# LW3 - Logistics W3

> LW3 (Logistics W3) builds post-quantum secure, EU-compliant Battery Passports for the global EV and industrial battery industry. The platform enables circular economy, supply chain transparency, and product lifecycle management through blockchain, agentic AI, and IoT.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.lw3.world/): LW3 Battery Passport platform - post-quantum blockchain, agentic AI, and IoT for EU battery regulation compliance.
- [What is LW3?](https://www.lw3.world/what-is-lw3): Full overview of LW3's technology, regulatory alignment, and use cases.
- [Phygital Identity (IoT)](https://www.lw3.world/phygital-iot/1): Physical battery identity anchored on-chain via IoT sensor data - tamper-proof, machine-readable, and globally verifiable.
- [Near Zero Carbon Infrastructure](https://www.lw3.world/near-zero-carbon/1): Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions tracked, verified, and anchored on-chain across the full battery supply chain.
- [Agentic AI Intelligence](https://www.lw3.world/agentic-ai/1): Autonomous agents monitor compliance, detect anomalies, and route batteries to second life at fleet scale.
- [Supply Chain Finance](https://www.lw3.world/supply-chain-finance/1): Verified Battery Passport data enables dynamic invoice discounting, asset-backed lending, and working capital solutions.
- [Carbon Footprint Engine](https://www.lw3.world/carbon-footprint/1): Lifecycle CO2 calculation per kWh to ISO 14040/14044 standards for EU Battery Regulation carbon declaration.
- [Post Quantum Secure Blockchain](https://www.lw3.world/post-quantum/1): Battery Passport records secured with NIST-standardised CRYSTALS-Dilithium signatures on Cardano.

## Regulatory Alignment

- [EU Battery Regulation (2023/1542)](https://www.lw3.world/): Battery Passport compliance mandate from February 2027.
- [CIRPASS EU Standardisation](https://www.lw3.world/): LW3 is a recognised contributor, March 2024.
- [NIS2 Directive](https://www.lw3.world/post-quantum/1): Post-quantum cryptographic readiness for critical infrastructure.
- [ISO 14040/14044](https://www.lw3.world/carbon-footprint/1): Lifecycle assessment methodology for carbon footprint declarations.
- [India Battery Adhaar (BPAN)](https://www.lw3.world/): India's national battery identity framework - LW3 achieved 80% alignment in pilot deployments.
- [ESPR - Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation](https://www.lw3.world/): EU regulation requiring digital product passports for sustainable product compliance.
- [EUDR - EU Deforestation Regulation](https://www.lw3.world/): Supply chain traceability and due diligence compliance.
